Messages.Body:
On VTES-L, Davey Bonnevalle writes:
> 1. Can a Caitif play Praxis Seizure to give itself a title?
> (Since Caitif is no clan). Can Pander play Crusades? (I assume yes,
> since they are a clan).

Yes to both. Praxis and Crusade (and other title-bestowing effects) care
only about the sect of the target, not about the target's clan (or lack
thereof).

> 2. Vamp A plays Dawn Operation with Drawing out the Beast. What happens
> with his opponent if his opponent plays Theft of Vitae Inf/Sup? Does he
> go into torpor or not?

He goes to torpor if he takes (and doesn't prevent) damage that he doesn't
heal (and aggravated damage is damage that cannot be healed).

Stealing blood has no bearing.

> 3. If you oust your prey by a bleed, can you start bleeding your new
> prey in the same turn?

Yes. You can bleed your prey as an action, whoever that happens to be
at the time.

> 4. Card contesting: If the other Metsuselah gives up contesting. When
> does the card become available again? Immediatly or later (during your
> next untap)?

During your next untap. [4.1]

> 5. I have 1 pool left in a 2 player game. I play Kine Resources
> Contested and then I regain blood with Voters Captivation. Am I dead
> immediatly or do I still live? (since it is still in the same action,
> that I regain the pool)

You are dead the moment you have zero pool (unless someone saves you
with a Life Boon or somesuch). You won't live long enough to play the
voter captivation. [RTR 10-NOV-95]
